items.title: Gucci Brings Latest Retail Concept to the U.K. Via Harrods
items.summary: WWD covers Gucci's relocated womenswear boutique inside Harrods, London — the first UK expression of the store concept unveiled at the Milan SS27 show, featuring travertine, walnut paneling and a Renaissance-palazzo spatial logic designed by Demna's team.

items.title: Gucci relocated Harrods boutique takes new concept to UK for first time
items.summary: Descriptive trade-press write-up of the new Harrods boutique's design codes (Italian heritage references, exploratory merchandising) with no independent evaluative verdict offered.

items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: Reports Gucci cut prices on handbags, footwear and RTW by up to 30% (e.g. Padlock bag from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450 in France); Kering called the move a correction for 'overpriced' items; Q3 revenue fell 6% comparable and Kering dropped its 2026 growth target.

items.title: Gucci's Price Cuts Expose a Bigger Problem for Luxury Fashion
items.summary: Analytical piece framing the Padlock bag's 30% price cut as symptomatic of a broader luxury affordability problem; notes Kering's admission that 'pricing was pushed too far in certain categories' while contrasting Hermes's 4% growth as proof pricing power is still achievable when merchandise resonates.

items.title: Gucci Discount Strategy Puts Pressure On Luxury Rivals. Louis Vuitton Isn't Following
items.summary: Reports Gucci broke an industry pricing taboo by cutting prices after 13 straight quarters of declining sales and over-aggressive price hikes since 2019; Louis Vuitton is holding its prices steady, betting on product appeal instead, setting up a strategic contrast between the two houses.

items.title: Kering: Gucci, le boulet de Luca de Meo
items.summary: French financial outlet frames Gucci as 'the deadweight' dragging on Kering: stock down 41% since January 2026, Gucci still 51% of group operating profit despite a 6% Q3 sales decline versus 5.4% expected; quotes an analyst saying the brand's vision 'still seems somewhat fuzzy to consumers' despite the GucciCore launch and Demna's initiatives.

items.title: Horlogerie: Gucci supprime 30 postes a Cortaillod
items.summary: Gucci Swiss Timepieces is cutting 30 of 95 jobs at its Cortaillod (Neuchatel) manufacture as logistics shift to Trecate, Italy; a union representative said the concern is 'knowing how far this situation will go' - the second layoff round in two years.

items.title: Gucci recortara 30 empleos en su division de relojeria en Suiza
items.summary: Spanish-language trade coverage corroborating the Cortaillod watch-division layoffs, adding Swiss watch export context (exports down 2.8% in 2024, 1.7% in 2025) industry-wide.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Roundup of organic public reaction to Gucci's Harmony Korine-directed holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey; fans called it 'boring', 'depressing', 'outdated' and compared the mood to a horror show, though some praised Carey's personal styling. This is independent public reaction to an activation, not the activation copy itself.

items.title: X post on Gucci's 30% price cuts vs Louis Vuitton holding firm
items.summary: Viral-style X post summarizing that Gucci cut prices by up to 30% after 13 straight quarters of declining sales while Louis Vuitton refuses to follow suit; post could not be fetched directly (paywall) so engagement counts are unavailable, but it was prominent enough to surface as a top search result for the story.

items.title: Gucci SS27 Show (PurseForum community thread)
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread on Demna's SS27 Gucci show; members described it as reminiscent of the pre-Tom Ford, bourgeois-aesthetic era with Demna's darker, moodier touches via hoodies and outerwear for men. Thread predates the 72-hour window but is the most current active PurseForum Gucci discussion found and reflects ongoing community sentiment; direct page fetch was blocked (403), so detail is search-snippet based only.

items.title: Is Gucci Good Again? 2026 Reset: La Famiglia RTW & New Glow Blushes Review
items.summary: Independent fashion/beauty YouTube reviewer asks whether Gucci's 2026 reset under Demna (La Famiglia ready-to-wear, new Glow blush line) is working; framed as a genuine critical review rather than brand-sponsored content, title itself signals skepticism pending the brand's turnaround.

items.title: Italian Trustpilot reviews cite poor quality-to-price ratio
items.summary: Aggregated Italian consumer reviews describe unglued belts needing EUR130 repairs, shoes degrading within four months, and tarnishing silver jewelry; reviewers call the price-to-quality ratio 'terrible' and say customers are 'paying only for the brand name'. Represents organic consumer complaint volume rather than a single dated article; dates span recent review pages.

items.title: Gucci's watch division will cut 30 jobs in Switzerland
items.summary: Wire-syndicated confirmation of the Cortaillod layoffs; kept as corroboration only, reach not summed separately per dedup policy since the Swiss-market original (20 Minutes) is the primary record.
